case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Verifiable authority before binding academic representation and before disclosure of confidential student information.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Although general protections in N088 (7.3), N077 (1.6), and N083 (5.1-5.2) bar third-party appeals, password sharing, and unauthorised personal data disclosure, no relevant verification mechanism was identified in the documents and searches checked for staff to confirm authority before binding representation or confidential disclosure when an AI agent uses a student's delegated SSO/email account.
case_summary.case_note: Murdoch's Student Appeals Procedure (N088, 7.3) prohibits another person from making an appeal on a student's behalf, while IT Conditions of Use (N077, 1.6) prohibits password sharing and Privacy Policy (N083) restricts personal information disclosure. However, no relevant verification boundary was identified in the documents and searches checked to prevent an AI agent using delegated SSO credentials from binding academic representation or receiving confidential student data in routine staff correspondence, leaving a critical gap. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15, and this proposal awaits human verification.
